title: Futu Partners with Cboe, the Largest U.S. Options Exchange, to Launch First Options Summit, Empowering Individual Investors to Advance into Professional Trading and Transforming Hong Kong’s Options Investment Landscape
summary: (Hong Kong, April 20, 2026) As market volatility intensifies, the demand for options as a tool for risk management and yield enhancement continues to grow. However, a significant awareness gap remains among individual investors. To break down knowledge barriers and empower more investors to navigate market fluctuations with greater confidence, Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited (“Futu”) is partnering with Cboe Global Markets (“Cboe”), the largest U.S. options exchange, to hold the “Mastering Volatility, Seizing Opportunities — Futu Options Summit 2026” on April 25.
